## About
We're a small garage on Willow Rd in Northfield. Folks around here know us through Mike, who one reviewer called "a one of a kind and honest mechanic" who fixes what needs to be fixed, not perfectly working parts.
We work on everything from high end vehicles to a Kia, and one reviewer says Mike is very talented with German cars. Your vehicle is serviced by our ASE-certified Master Technicians, and we work to get it back to you as quickly as we can.
One customer has Mike look after the cars of his kids, his mother and his best friend's family. He also mentioned the free jokes, though not all of them are winners.

## Services
- Diagnosis: Engine, electrical and electronic: Tracking down what's actually wrong with your engine, electrical or electronic systems before anything gets replaced.
- Engine tune-up and overhaul: From a routine tune-up to a full engine overhaul.
- Transmission/drive train repairs: Repairs to your transmission and drive train.
- Electronic and electrical repairs: Fixing the electronic and electrical problems that keep a car from running right.
- Steering and suspension: Work on steering and suspension so the car handles the way it should.
- Shocks and struts: Shock and strut replacement. One customer wrote that after his new struts, the squeaky noise was gone too.
- Fuel injection: Service and repair for fuel injection systems.
- Lube and oil change: Regular lube and oil changes to keep your car in good shape.

## FAQ

A: We're a small garage, and one reviewer says we work on everything from high end vehicles to a Kia. Another reviewer says Mike is very talented with German cars.

Q: When are you open?
